content.title: Coachella 2026 weekend two passes are still available: Secure last-minute ticket deals now
content.text: Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G. are the 2026 Coachella headliners.Breanna ManleyIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Breanna Manley | bmanley@al.comCoachella 2026 is officially here, and while some festivalgoers are busy setting up campsites and preparing for opening weekend (April 10-12), music lovers who waited just a bit too long to purchase tickets are left scrambling. Luckily for those still eager to catch this year’s star-studded lineup of artists, which includes headliners Justin Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G., passes for the second and final weekend of Coachella 2026 (April 17-19) are still available for purchase and can be found on a variety of secondary markets that offer great deals and exclusive promo codes. How to grab last-minute Coachella 2026 weekend two passesFestivalgoers hoping to secure last-minute tickets to the second and final weekend of Coachella 2026 can find passes available on Vivid Seats, StubHub, Viagogo and Seat Geek. Out of these secondary markets, both Vivid Seats and Seat Geek have active promo codes to enjoy. First-time Vivid Seats customers can enjoy $30 off their first order of $200+ by using promo code ADVANCE30 at checkout, while Seat Geek customers can take $5 off orders of $300+ by using code TAKE5 at checkout. Below you can find the current ticket prices for Coachella weekend two (April 17-19).Vivid Seats: $1,313 per personStubHub: $1,130 per personViagogo: $1,055 per personSeat Geek: $1,373 per personCoachella 2026 lineupAs mentioned previously, Justin Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G. are leading this year’s lineup as headliners while other notable acts include Teddy Swims, KATSEYE, The Strokes, Addison Rae, Labrinth, sombr, Young Thug, Iggpy Pop, CLIPSE and more.
